title: Care Desk Guidance on Cancelling Title & Registration Services Orders and Refunding State Fees
content:
When the purchase is cancelled or the vehicle returned before the Title & Registration Services order has been submitted, the order is cancelled and every held state fee is refunded to the buyer as its own refund entry within the service type's state fee refund business days. An order is cancelled from the statuses awaiting documents, ready to submit or rejected.

A held fee is refunded only on an order whose status is cancelled or completed.

Fees already remitted to the state are not refunded when the service type's switch for refunds after submission is No. When the vehicle is returned after registration was issued, Kestrel retitles the vehicle at its own cost and the buyer's remitted fees are not refunded.

A fee collected in excess of the schedule is refunded after completion.

A registration address may be corrected before submission without cancelling the order, and a buyer may switch between plate transfer and new plates before submission where the service type allows it, with the fee entries adjusted to the new service type's fee components.

## The guidance in one table

| What happened | When | Order | Held state fees |
|---|---|---|---|
| purchase cancelled or vehicle returned | before submission | cancelled | each refunded as its own entry within the refund period |
| vehicle returned | after registration was issued | Kestrel retitles at its own cost | remitted fees not refunded |
| fee collected above the schedule | order completed | completed | the excess refunded after completion |
| registration address corrected | before submission | continues, no cancellation | unchanged |
| switch between plate transfer and new plates, where allowed | before submission | continues under the new service type | fee entries adjusted to the new service type's components |

## Refund status test

| Order status | Held fee may be refunded |
|---|---|
| cancelled, completed | yes |
| awaiting documents, ready to submit, submitted, rejected, registered | no |

## Hypothetical illustration

An order holding a title fee, a registration fee and a temp tag fee is cancelled before submission because the vehicle was returned: three refund entries are made, one per held fee, within the refund period of the order's service type.
